verses.en: Hearken, O ye elders of my church, who have assembled yourselves together in my name, even Jesus Christ the Son of the living God, the Savior of the world; inasmuch as ye believe on my name and keep my commandments.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou e toeaina o la’u ekalesia, o e ua outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava i lo’u igoa, o Iesu Keriso lava le Atalii o le Atua soifua, le Faaola o le lalolagi; e tusa ai ua outou talitonu i lo’u igoa ma tausi i a’u poloaiga.

verses.en: Again I say unto you, hearken and hear and obey the law which I shall give unto you.
verses.sm: Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, faalogo ma faafofoga ma usiusitai i le tulafono o le a Ou tuu atu ia te outou.

verses.en: For verily I say, as ye have assembled yourselves together according to the commandment wherewith I commanded you, and are agreed as touching this one thing, and have asked the Father in my name, even so ye shall receive.
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu, talu ai ona ua outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava e tusa ma le poloaiga na Ou poloaiina ai outou, ma ua outou autasi e faatatau i lenei mea e tasi, ma sa outou ole atu ai i le Tamā i lo’u igoa, o le a faapea lava ona outou maua.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, I give unto you this first commandment, that ye shall go forth in my name, every one of you, excepting my servants Joseph Smith, Jun., and Sidney Rigdon.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou le poloaiga muamua lenei, ia outou o atu i lo’u igoa, outou uma taitoatasi, vagana ai a’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Sini Rikitone.

verses.en: And I give unto them a commandment that they shall go forth for a little season, and it shall be given by the power of the Spirit when they shall return.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te i laua se poloaiga ia laua o atu mo se vaitau itiiti, ma o le a tuu atu e le mana o le Agaga le taimi la te toe foi mai ai.

verses.en: And ye shall go forth in the power of my Spirit, preaching my gospel, two by two, in my name, lifting up your voices as with the sound of a trump, declaring my word like unto angels of God.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou o atu i le mana o lo’u Agaga, ma talai atu la’u talalelei, taitoalua, i lo’u igoa, ma sii a’e o outou leo faapei o le leo o se pu, e alaga atu la’u upu e pei o agelu a le Atua.

verses.en: And ye shall go forth baptizing with water, saying: Repent ye, repent ye, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou o atu ma papatiso atu i le vai, fai atu: Inā outou salamo ia, inā outou salamo ia, ona ua oo mai le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: And from this place ye shall go forth into the regions westward; and inasmuch as ye shall find them that will receive you ye shall build up my church in every region—
verses.sm: Ma mai i lenei nofoaga, ia outou o atu ai i nofoaga i sisifo; ma e tusa ai ma lo outou mauaina o i latou o e o le a latou taliaina outou, ia outou atia’e la’u ekalesia i itulagi uma—

verses.en: Until the time shall come when it shall be revealed unto you from on high, when the city of the New Jerusalem shall be prepared, that ye may be gathered in one, that ye may be my people and I will be your God.
verses.sm: Sei oo i le taimi o le a faaali atu ai ia te outou mai luga, le taimi o le a saunia ai le aai o le Ierusalema Fou, ina ia mafai ona faapotopotoina outou i se tino e tasi, ina ia mafai ona avea outou ma o’u nuu ma o le a avea A’u ma o outou Atua.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, that my servant Edward Partridge shall stand in the office whereunto I have appointed him. And it shall come to pass, that if he transgress another shall be appointed in his stead. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a tulai pea la’u auauna o Eteuati Paterika i le tofiga ua Ou tofia i ai o ia. Ma o le a oo mai, afai e solitulafono o ia, o le a tofia se tasi i lona tulaga. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: Again I say unto you, that it shall not be given to any one to go forth to preach my gospel, or to build up my church, except he be ordained by some one who has authority, and it is known to the church that he has authority and has been regularly ordained by the heads of the church.
verses.sm: O lenei foi Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, o le a lē tuuina atu i soo se tasi e alu e talai atu la’u talalelei, pe ati a’e la’u ekalesia, vagana ai ua faauuina o ia e se tasi ua i ai le pule, ma ua lauiloa i le ekalesia ua ia te ia le pule ma ua faauuina o ia i le ala e tatau ai e ao o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And again, the elders, priests and teachers of this church shall teach the principles of my gospel, which are in the Bible and the Book of Mormon, in the which is the fulness of the gospel.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia aoao atu e toeaina, ositaulaga ma aoao o lenei ekalesia, mataupu autu o la’u talalelei, ua i ai i totonu o le Tusi Paia ma le Tusi a Mamona, ua i ai le atoatoaga o le talalelei.

verses.en: And they shall observe the covenants and church articles to do them, and these shall be their teachings, as they shall be directed by the Spirit.
verses.sm: Ma ia latou vaai ia faia feagaiga ma mataupu faavae o le ekalesia, ma o mea ia ia latou aoao atu, e pei ona o le a taitaiina ai i latou e le Agaga.

verses.en: And the Spirit shall be given unto you by the prayer of faith; and if ye receive not the Spirit ye shall not teach.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tuu atu ia te outou le Agaga e ala i le tatalo o le faatuatua; ma afai tou te lē maua le Agaga aua tou te aoao atu.

verses.en: And all this ye shall observe to do as I have commanded concerning your teaching, until the fulness of my scriptures is given.
verses.sm: Ma o nei mea uma ia outou vaai ia faia e pei ona Ou poloaiina e faatatau ia outou aoaoga, sei oo ina tuuina atu le atoatoaga o a’u tusitusiga paia.

verses.en: And as ye shall lift up your voices by the Comforter, ye shall speak and prophesy as seemeth me good;
verses.sm: Ma a’o siitia a’e o outou leo e ala i le Fesoasoani, o le a outou tautatala ma vavalo atu e pei ona lelei ia te a’u;

verses.en: For, behold, the Comforter knoweth all things, and beareth record of the Father and of the Son.
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, ua silafia e le Fesoasoani mea uma, ma ua molimau e uiga i le Tamā ma le Atalii.

verses.en: And now, behold, I speak unto the church. Thou shalt not kill; and he that kills shall not have forgiveness in this world, nor in the world to come.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te tautala atu i le ekalesia. Aua e te fasioti tagata; ma o ia o lē e fasioti tagata o le a lē maua se faamagaloga i le lalolagi lenei, po o i le lalolagi a sau.

verses.en: And again, I say, thou shalt not kill; but he that killeth shall die.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu, aua e te fasioti tagata; ae o ia e fasioti tagata o le a oti.

verses.en: Thou shalt not steal; and he that stealeth and will not repent shall be cast out.
verses.sm: Aua e te gaoi; ma o ia o lē e gaoi ma lē salamo o le a tuli i fafo.

verses.en: Thou shalt not lie; he that lieth and will not repent shall be cast out.
verses.sm: Aua e te pepelo; o ia o lē e pepelo ma lē salamo o le a tuli i fafo.

verses.en: Thou shalt love thy wife with all thy heart, and shalt cleave unto her and none else.
verses.sm: Ia e alofa i lau ava ma lou loto atoa, ma ia e pipii atu ia te ia ae lē o se isi.

verses.en: And he that looketh upon a woman to lust after her shall deny the faith, and shall not have the Spirit; and if he repents not he shall be cast out.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e vaai atu i se fafine i le manao ia te ia, o le a faafiti e ia le faatuatua, ma o le a lē maua e ia le Agaga; ma afai e lē salamo o ia o le a tuli o ia i fafo.

verses.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery; and he that committeth adultery, and repenteth not, shall be cast out.
verses.sm: Aua e te mulilua; ma o ia o lē e mulilua, ma lē salamo, o le a tuli i fafo.

verses.en: But he that has committed adultery and repents with all his heart, and forsaketh it, and doeth it no more, thou shalt forgive;
verses.sm: Peitai o ia o lē ua mulilua ma ua salamo ma lona loto atoa, ma lafoai i ai, ma lē toe faia, ia outou faamagaloina.

verses.en: But if he doeth it again, he shall not be forgiven, but shall be cast out.
verses.sm: Ae afai e toe faia e ia, o le a lē faamagaloina o ia, ae o le a tuli i fafo.

verses.en: Thou shalt not speak evil of thy neighbor, nor do him any harm.
verses.sm: Aua e te tautala leaga e uiga i lē lua te tuaoi, pe faatiga ia te ia.

verses.en: Thou knowest my laws concerning these things are given in my scriptures; he that sinneth and repenteth not shall be cast out.
verses.sm: Ua outou iloa o a’u tulafono e faatatau i nei mea ua tuu atu i totonu o a’u tusitusiga paia; o o ia o lē e agasala ma lē salamo o le a tuli i fafo.

verses.en: If thou lovest me thou shalt serve me and keep all my commandments.
verses.sm: Afai e te alofa mai ia te a’u, e te auauna mai ia te a’u ma tausi i a’u poloaiga uma.

verses.en: And behold, thou wilt remember the poor, and consecrate of thy properties for their support that which thou hast to impart unto them, with a covenant and a deed which cannot be broken.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ia e manatua e ua matitiva, ma ia faapaiaina mo lo latou tausiga ni mea mai au meatotino ua ia te oe e faasoa atu ia te i latou, faatasi ma se feagaiga ma se pepa faamaonia mo meatotino e lē mafai ona solia.

verses.en: And inasmuch as ye impart of your substance unto the poor, ye will do it unto me; and they shall be laid before the bishop of my church and his counselors, two of the elders, or high priests, such as he shall appoint or has appointed and set apart for that purpose.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma la outou faasoa atu o a outou mea i e ua matitiva, ia outou faia ia te a’u; ma ia folasia atu ia mea i luma o le epikopo o la’u ekalesia ma ona fesoasoani, o ni toeaina e toalua, po o ni faitaulaga sili, o i laua ia o le a ia tofia pe ua ia tofia ma vaetofia mo lena faamoemoe.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that after they are laid before the bishop of my church, and after that he has received these testimonies concerning the consecration of the properties of my church, that they cannot be taken from the church, agreeable to my commandments, every man shall be made accountable unto me, a steward over his own property, or that which he has received by consecration, as much as is sufficient for himself and family.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai a uma ona folasia atu o ia mea i luma o le epikopo o la’u ekalesia, ma a uma ona ia maua o ia molimau e faatatau i le faapaiaga o meatotino a la’u ekalesia, e lē mafai ona aveesea o ia mea mai le ekalesia, e tusa ai ma a’u poloaiga, ia faia ia tali mai tagata uma taitoatasi ia te a’u, o se tausimea i luga o ana lava meatotino, po o mea ua ia maua e ala mai i le faapaiaga, e tusa ma le tele ua tatau ai mo ia lava ma le aiga.

verses.en: And again, if there shall be properties in the hands of the church, or any individuals of it, more than is necessary for their support after this first consecration, which is a residue to be consecrated unto the bishop, it shall be kept to administer to those who have not, from time to time, that every man who has need may be amply supplied and receive according to his wants.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, afai e i ai ni meatotino i lima o le ekalesia, po o ni ona tagata taitoatasi, ua sili atu nai lo mea ua tatau ai mo lo latou tausiga pe a uma lenei faapaiaga muamua, o se toega lea e faapaia atu i le epikopo, ia teuina e avatu ia te i latou o e ua leai ni mea, mai lea taimi i lea taimi, ina ia lava tuuina atu ma maua e tagata uma taitoatasi o e ua manaomia ni mea, e tusa ma ona manao.

verses.en: Therefore, the residue shall be kept in my storehouse, to administer to the poor and the needy, as shall be appointed by the high council of the church, and the bishop and his council;
verses.sm: O lea, o mea e totoe ia teu i lo’u faleteuoloa, e avatu i e ua matitiva ma e ua lē tagolima, e pei ona o le a tofia ai e le aufono maualuga o le ekalesia, ma le epikopo ma lana aufono;

verses.en: And for the purpose of purchasing lands for the public benefit of the church, and building houses of worship, and building up of the New Jerusalem which is hereafter to be revealed—
verses.sm: Ma mo le faamoemoe o le faatauina mai o fanua mo le manuia lautele o le ekalesia, ma le fausia o fale tapuai, ma le atiina’eina o le Ierusalema Fou lea o le a faaali atu mulimuli mai—

verses.en: That my covenant people may be gathered in one in that day when I shall come to my temple. And this I do for the salvation of my people.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona faapotopotoina o lo’u nuu o le feagaiga i se tino e tasi i lena aso pe a Ou alu atu i lo’u malumalu. Ma o le a Ou faia lenei mea mo le faaolataga o o’u tagata.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that he that sinneth and repenteth not shall be cast out of the church, and shall not receive again that which he has consecrated unto the poor and the needy of my church, or in other words, unto me—
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, o le a tuli ese i fafo o le ekalesia o ia o lē e agasala ma lē salamo, ma o le a lē toe mauaina e ia mea na ia faapaia mai mo e ua matitiva ma lē tagolima o la’u ekalesia, po o i ni isi upu, ia te a’u—

verses.en: For inasmuch as ye do it unto the least of these, ye do it unto me.
verses.sm: E faapei ona outou faia o ia mea i se aupito itiiti o i latou nei, ua outou faia ia mea ia te a’u.

verses.en: For it shall come to pass, that which I spake by the mouths of my prophets shall be fulfilled; for I will consecrate of the riches of those who embrace my gospel among the Gentiles unto the poor of my people who are of the house of Israel.
verses.sm: Aua o le a oo mai le faataunuuina o mea na Ou tautala atu ai e ala i fofoga o a’u perofeta; ona o le a Ou faapaiaina ni mea mai oloa a i latou o e e taliaina la’u talalelei i totonu o Nuuese, mo e ua matitiva o lo’u nuu o e o le aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And again, thou shalt not be proud in thy heart; let all thy garments be plain, and their beauty the beauty of the work of thine own hands;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, aua e te faamaualuga i lou loto; ia faafaigofie ou ofu uma, ma o lo latou matagofie ia tuu ia faia i le matagofie o galuega a ou lava lima;

verses.en: And let all things be done in cleanliness before me.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i mea uma ia faia i le mama i o’u luma.

verses.en: Thou shalt not be idle; for he that is idle shall not eat the bread nor wear the garments of the laborer.
verses.sm: Aua e te paie; ona o ia e paie o le a lē ’aia le areto pe ofu i ofu o lē e galue.

verses.en: And whosoever among you are sick, and have not faith to be healed, but believe, shall be nourished with all tenderness, with herbs and mild food, and that not by the hand of an enemy.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi e i totonu o outou ua ma’i, ma ua leai se faatuatua e faamaloloina ai, ae ua talitonu, ia tausia ma le faapelepele atoa, i laau-afu ma meaai vaivai, ae lē i le lima o se fili.

verses.en: And the elders of the church, two or more, shall be called, and shall pray for and lay their hands upon them in my name; and if they die they shall die unto me, and if they live they shall live unto me.
verses.sm: Ma ia valaauina ni toeaina o le ekalesia, e toalua pe sili atu, e tatalo mo i latou ma faaee o latou lima i luga o i latou i lo’u igoa; ma afai e oti i latou e oti i latou ia te a’u, ma afai e ola i latou e ola i latou ia te a’u.

verses.en: Thou shalt live together in love, insomuch that thou shalt weep for the loss of them that die, and more especially for those that have not hope of a glorious resurrection.
verses.sm: Ia outou nonofo faatasi i le alofa, ia outou fetagisi ai i le toesea o i latou o e ua oti, ma aemaise lava mo i latou o e ua leai se faamoemoe mo se toetutu mamalu.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that those that die in me shall not taste of death, for it shall be sweet unto them;
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a lē tofo i le oti i latou o e e oti ia te a’u, aua o le a suamalie ia te i latou;

verses.en: And they that die not in me, wo unto them, for their death is bitter.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e lē oti ia te a’u, oi talofa ia te i latou, aua e oona lo latou oti.

verses.en: And again, it shall come to pass that he that hath faith in me to be healed, and is not appointed unto death, shall be healed.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a oo mai e faamaloloina o ia o lē ua faatuatua mai ia te a’u, ma ua lē tofia e oti, o le a faamaloloina.

verses.en: He who hath faith to see shall see.
verses.sm: O ia o lē ua i ai le faatuatua e vaai ai o le a vaai.

verses.en: He who hath faith to hear shall hear.
verses.sm: O ia o lē ua i ai le faatuatua e faalogo ai o le a faalogo.

verses.en: The lame who hath faith to leap shall leap.
verses.sm: O le pipili o lē ua i ai le faatuatua e oso ai o le a oso.

verses.en: And they who have not faith to do these things, but believe in me, have power to become my sons; and inasmuch as they break not my laws thou shalt bear their infirmities.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e ua lē i ai le faatuatua e faia ai nei mea, ae ua talitonu mai ia te a’u, ua i ai le mana e avea ai mo o’u atalii; ma e tusa ai ma lo latou lē solia o a’u tulafono, ia e tauaveina o latou vaivaiga.

verses.en: Thou shalt stand in the place of thy stewardship.
verses.sm: Ia e tulai i le tulaga o lau mea-tausi.

verses.en: Thou shalt not take thy brother’s garment; thou shalt pay for that which thou shalt receive of thy brother.
verses.sm: Aua e te ave le ofu o lou uso; ia e totogi mo mea e te maua mai lou uso.

verses.en: And if thou obtainest more than that which would be for thy support, thou shalt give it into my storehouse, that all things may be done according to that which I have said.
verses.sm: Ma afai e te maua ni mea e sili atu nai lo mea mo lou tausiga, ia e tuu atu ia mea i lo’u faleteuoloa, ina ia mafai ona faia o mea uma e tusa ai ma mea ua Ou fai atu ai.

verses.en: Thou shalt ask, and my scriptures shall be given as I have appointed, and they shall be preserved in safety;
verses.sm: Ia e ole mai, ma o le a tuuina atu ai a’u tusitusiga paia e pei ona Ou tofia, ma o le a faasaoina i latou i le saogalemu;

verses.en: And it is expedient that thou shouldst hold thy peace concerning them, and not teach them until ye have received them in full.
verses.sm: Ma ua tatau ai ia te oe ona taofi lou filemu e faatatau i ia tusitusiga paia, ma lē aoaoina atu i latou seia e mauaina i latou i le atoatoa.

verses.en: And I give unto you a commandment that then ye shall teach them unto all men; for they shall be taught unto all nations, kindreds, tongues and people.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ona outou aoao atu ai lea o i latou i tagata uma; ona o le a aoao atu i latou i atunuu uma, ituaiga, gagana ma nuu.

verses.en: Thou shalt take the things which thou hast received, which have been given unto thee in my scriptures for a law, to be my law to govern my church;
verses.sm: Ia e ave mea ua e mauaina, ia na tuu atu ia te oe i a’u tusitusiga paia mo se tulafono, e avea ma a’u tulafono e pulea ai la’u ekalesia;

verses.en: And he that doeth according to these things shall be saved, and he that doeth them not shall be damned if he so continue.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē na te faia e tusa ma nei mea, o le a faaolaina, ma o ia o lē na te lē faia ia mea o le a malaia pe afai e faaauau pea o ia faapea.

verses.en: If thou shalt ask, thou shalt receive revelation upon revelation, knowledge upon knowledge, that thou mayest know the mysteries and peaceable things—that which bringeth joy, that which bringeth life eternal.
verses.sm: Afai e te ole mai, o le a e maua lea faaaliga e faaopoopo i luga o lea faaaliga, lea malamalama e faaopoopo i luga o lea malamalama, ina ia mafai ona e iloa mealilo ma mea filemu— o mea ia e maua ai le olioli, o mea ia e maua ai le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: Thou shalt ask, and it shall be revealed unto you in mine own due time where the New Jerusalem shall be built.
verses.sm: Ia e ole mai, ma o le a faaali atu ia te oe i lo’u lava taimi e tatau ai le mea o le a faatuina ai le Ierusalema Fou.

verses.en: And behold, it shall come to pass that my servants shall be sent forth to the east and to the west, to the north and to the south.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o le a oo mai o le a auina atu a’u auauna i sasae ma sisifo, i matu ma i saute.

verses.en: And even now, let him that goeth to the east teach them that shall be converted to flee to the west, and this in consequence of that which is coming on the earth, and of secret combinations.
verses.sm: Ma i le taimi nei lava, ia tuu atu ia te ia o lē e alu atu i sasae ia aoaoina i latou o e o le a liliu mai, ia sosola atu i sisifo, ma o le pogai o lenei mea ona o mea o le a oo mai i luga o le lalolagi, ma ona o faapotopotoga faalilolilo.

verses.en: Behold, thou shalt observe all these things, and great shall be thy reward; for unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom, but unto the world it is not given to know them.
verses.sm: Faauta, ia e tausia nei mea uma, ma o le a tele lava lou taui; ona ua tuu atu ia te outou ia outou iloaina mealilo o le malo, ae ua lē tuuina atu i le lalolagi ia latou iloaina.

verses.en: Ye shall observe the laws which ye have received and be faithful.
verses.sm: Ia outou tausia tulafono ua outou maua ma ia faamaoni.

verses.en: And ye shall hereafter receive church covenants, such as shall be sufficient to establish you, both here and in the New Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ma o le a outou maua i se taimi o mulimuli mai feagaiga o le ekalesia, ia o le a lava e faatutumau ai outou iinei ma i le Ierusalema Fou.

verses.en: Therefore, he that lacketh wisdom, let him ask of me, and I will give him liberally and upbraid him not.
verses.sm: O lea, o ia o lē ua lē o i ai se poto, ia tuu atu ia te ia e ole mai ia te a’u, ma o le a Ou foai tele atu ia te ia ma lē aoaiina o ia.

verses.en: Lift up your hearts and rejoice, for unto you the kingdom, or in other words, the keys of the church have been given. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ia siitia a’e o outou loto ma olioli, ona ua tuu atu ia te outou le malo, pe faapea foi, o ki o le ekalesia. Ua faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: The priests and teachers shall have their stewardships, even as the members.
verses.sm: O le a maua e ositaulaga ma aoao a latou matafaioi, e pei lava o tagata o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And the elders or high priests who are appointed to assist the bishop as counselors in all things, are to have their families supported out of the property which is consecrated to the bishop, for the good of the poor, and for other purposes, as before mentioned;
verses.sm: Ma o toeaina po o faitaulaga sili o e ua tofia e lagolago i le epikopo o ni fesoasoani i mea uma, ia tausia o latou aiga mai meatotino ua faapaia atu i le epikopo, mo le lelei o e ua matitiva, ma mo isi faamoemoega, e pei ona ta’ua atu muamua;

verses.en: Or they are to receive a just remuneration for all their services, either a stewardship or otherwise, as may be thought best or decided by the counselors and bishop.
verses.sm: Pe ia latou maua se totogi tatau ai mo a latou auaunaga uma, pe i se mea-tausi po o se isi mea, e pei ona manatu pe filifili i ai le epikopo ma ona fesoasoani ua sili ona lelei.

verses.en: And the bishop, also, shall receive his support, or a just remuneration for all his services in the church.
verses.sm: Ma ia maua foi e le epikopo lona tausiga, po o se totogi tatau ai, mo ana auaunaga uma i le ekalesia.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, that whatever persons among you, having put away their companions for the cause of fornication, or in other words, if they shall testify before you in all lowliness of heart that this is the case, ye shall not cast them out from among you;
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o ai lava ni tagata i totonu o outou, ua tuu ese a latou soa ona o le faitaaga, po o i ni isi upu, afai latou te molimau mai i o outou luma i le maualalo atoa o le loto o le tulaga lea ua i ai, aua tou te tutuliesea i latou mai totonu o outou;

verses.en: But if ye shall find that any persons have left their companions for the sake of adultery, and they themselves are the offenders, and their companions are living, they shall be cast out from among you.
verses.sm: Ae afai tou te maua ni tagata ua latou tuua a latou soa ona o le mulilua, ma o i latou lava ua solitulafono, ma o loo soifua pea a latou soa, ia tutuliese i latou mai i totonu o outou.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, that ye shall be watchful and careful, with all inquiry, that ye receive none such among you if they are married;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia outou mataala ma faaeteete, i le suesue lelei atoa, ina ia outou lē talia ni isi faapea i totonu o outou, pe afai ua faaipoipoina i latou;

verses.en: And if they are not married, they shall repent of all their sins or ye shall not receive them.
verses.sm: Ma afai e lei faaipoipoina i latou, ia latou salamo ia latou agasala uma, po ua outou lē taliaina i latou.

verses.en: And again, every person who belongeth to this church of Christ, shall observe to keep all the commandments and covenants of the church.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o tagata uma taitoatasi o e ua i ai i lenei ekalesia a Keriso, ia vaai ia latou tausia poloaiga ma feagaiga uma o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that if any persons among you shall kill they shall be delivered up and dealt with according to the laws of the land; for remember that he hath no forgiveness; and it shall be proved according to the laws of the land.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, afai e i ai ni tagata o outou e fasioti tagata, ia avatu i latou i luga ma faia ia te i latou e tusa ai ma tulafono o le laueleele; aua ia manatua ua leai se faamagaloga mo ia; ma ia faamaonia lena mea e tusa ma tulafono o le laueleele.

verses.en: And if any man or woman shall commit adultery, he or she shall be tried before two elders of the church, or more, and every word shall be established against him or her by two witnesses of the church, and not of the enemy; but if there are more than two witnesses it is better.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faia e soo se alii po o se tamaitai le mulilua, ia faamasinoina o ia i luma o ni toeaina e toalua, pe sili atu, o le ekalesia, ma ia faamautuina upu uma e faasaga i lea alii po o le tamaitai e ni molimau e toalua o le ekalesia, ae lē o le fili; ae afai ua sili atu i le toalua ni molimau ua i ai, ua sili atu ona lelei.

verses.en: But he or she shall be condemned by the mouth of two witnesses; and the elders shall lay the case before the church, and the church shall lift up their hands against him or her, that they may be dealt with according to the law of God.
verses.sm: Peitai o fofoga o molimau e toalua e tausalaina ai lea alii po o le tamaitai; ma ia folasia atu e toeaina le moliaga i luma o le ekalesia, ma ia siitia a’e e le ekalesia o latou lima e faasaga i lea alii po o le tamaitai, ina ia mafai ona faia ia te i laua e tusa ai ma le tulafono a le Atua.

verses.en: And if it can be, it is necessary that the bishop be present also.
verses.sm: Ma afai e mafai, e tatau i le epikopo ona auai foi.

verses.en: And thus ye shall do in all cases which shall come before you.
verses.sm: Ma ia faapea ona outou faia i moliaga uma e oo mai i o outou luma.

verses.en: And if a man or woman shall rob, he or she shall be delivered up unto the law of the land.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faomea se alii po o se tamaitai, ia avatu lea alii po o le tamaitai i luma o le tulafono o le laueleele.

verses.en: And if he or she shall steal, he or she shall be delivered up unto the law of the land.
verses.sm: Ma afai e gaoi se alii po o se tamaitai, ia avatu lea alii po o le tamaitai i luma o le tulafono o le laueleele.

verses.en: And if he or she shall lie, he or she shall be delivered up unto the law of the land.
verses.sm: Ma afai e pepelo se alii po o se tamaitai, ia avatu lea alii po o le tamaitai i luma o le tulafono o le laueleele.

verses.en: And if he or she do any manner of iniquity, he or she shall be delivered up unto the law, even that of God.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faia e se alii po o se tamaitai soo se ituaiga o amioletonu, ia avatu lea alii po o le tamaitai i le tulafono, le tulafono lava a le Atua.

verses.en: And if thy brother or sister offend thee, thou shalt take him or her between him or her and thee alone; and if he or she confess thou shalt be reconciled.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faatausuai mai sou uso po o sou tuafafine ia te oe, ia e ave lea uso po o lea tuafafine tau lava o ia ma oe; ma afai e ta’uta’u mai e lea uso po o lea tuafafine, ia e faalelei atu i ai.

verses.en: And if he or she confess not thou shalt deliver him or her up unto the church, not to the members, but to the elders. And it shall be done in a meeting, and that not before the world.
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē ta’uta’u mai e lea alii po o lea tuafafine, ia e avatu lea alii po o le tuafafine i luma o le ekalesia, e lē i tagata o le ekalesia, ae i toeaina. Ma ia faia lea i se fono, ae lē o luma o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And if thy brother or sister offend many, he or she shall be chastened before many.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faatausuai sou uso po o sou tuafafine i ni tagata e toatele, ia aoaia o ia i luma o tagata e toatele.

verses.en: And if any one offend openly, he or she shall be rebuked openly, that he or she may be ashamed. And if he or she confess not, he or she shall be delivered up unto the law of God.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faatausuai aliali se tasi, ia aoaiina faaaliali lea alii po o le tamaitai, ina ia faamaasiasi lea alii po o le tamaitai. Ma afai e lē ta’uta’u mai e lea alii po o le tamaitai, ia avatu lea alii po o le tamaitai i luga i le tulafono a le Atua.

verses.en: If any shall offend in secret, he or she shall be rebuked in secret, that he or she may have opportunity to confess in secret to him or her whom he or she has offended, and to God, that the church may not speak reproachfully of him or her.
verses.sm: Afai e i ai se e faatausuai faalilolilo, ia aoaiina faalilolilo lea alii po o le tamaitai, ina ia mafai ona maua e lea alii po o le tamaitai le avanoa e ta’uta’u faalilolilo atu ai i le alii po o le tamaitai na faatausuai i ai, ma i le Atua, ina ia lē ta’u inosia lea alii po o le tamaitai e le ekalesia.

verses.en: And thus shall ye conduct in all things.
verses.sm: Ma ia faapea ona outou faia i mea uma.
